note: The Oakhaven scrapbook: every camera roll from every mission. Newest first. Each photo lives in scrapbook/<id>-<n>.jpg (1080x1350) with a 432x540 copy in scrapbook/thumbs/. 'who' lists the survivors in a photo; a photo without 'who' counts everyone in the roll's crew.

rolls.intro: You voted WATER TOWER. Frost, Toast and Shawn went into the woods off Elm Street. Kim carried the camera.
rolls.outro: Clean water runs to the laundromat now. And the crew came home with a dog.

photos.note: The old tower was still standing. Frost knew it would be.
Frost found the main valve. Shawn watched the trees.
Something was living under the tower. It didn't run.
The pipes knocked all night, and they heard it. Toast kept them back.
Day 13. The ladder gave out under Kim. She says she's fine.
The water's running. And we came home with one more.

rolls.intro: Three of you asked for a second group. Sam, Artemis and Spenz took the gun shop. Artemis carried the camera.
rolls.outro: 34 rounds came home. So did a sighting of the twins.

photos.note: The grate was still locked. Nobody had been inside since it fell.
Sam took the lock. Spenz watched the street.
Every rack was empty. Someone got here first.
Under the pawn counter: 12 rounds they missed.
The stockroom wasn't empty. Sam went first.
Two ammo cans on the top shelf. 34 rounds in all.
Two blue coats on Mill Street. They never looked back.

rolls.intro: Three days inside the police station. Quinn was on overwatch the whole job, so the camera rode in his pocket.
rolls.outro: We went in to cut the chains. We came home with one more.

photos.note: Day 7. Carl's bolt cutters on the chain. Asa watched the street.
Day 7. Javier took a hit in the dark lobby. Concussion. Carl patched him up and sent him home.
Day 8. Behind the front desk: a water cooler, still full. +10 water.
Day 8. Rain all night. Jack and Asa held the doors. The dead pressed on the glass until morning.
Day 9. The basement. The cage was locked from the inside.
Day 9. Officer Reyes. Chained in since week two, with a police radio.
Day 9. Walking home in new riot vests with 120 rounds.

rolls.intro: Horde night. Sam couldn't swing an axe with cracked ribs, so he took the camera up the lookout tower.
rolls.outro: 97 of them hit the fence. The fence held. Sixty percent of it, anyway.

photos.note: From the tower. They came down the street in one long line.
Jaylozy's fire axe and Seth's maul, right through the chain link.
Jack's rifle. For a second you could see all of them.
Jeremy's bayonet spear and Francis's boat hook. They kept coming.
The whole fence, every side.
Day 8, sunrise. Asa never left his bucket.
Day 8. Carl, Quinn, Javier, Asa, Tanny and Francis walked out the gate anyway.

rolls.intro: Jack had the camera today. Three of us walked out there with zero rounds.
rolls.outro: We came home with 3 guns, 4 blades and axes, 60 rounds, and two sets of cracked ribs.

photos.note: Sam and Gabe on the forest road. Nobody had been out here since it started.
The gun locker was padlocked. Sam's crowbar, Gabe's flashlight.
Three guns, blades, axes, and 60 rounds. Jack went straight for the rifle.
Then the door opened. One of the big ones, all the way from the docks.
Sam's machete and Gabe's hatchet put it down. Gabe taped Sam up first, then himself.
The long walk home. Nobody talked.

rolls.intro: Francis found a camera at Pier 9 today. He spent the rest of the day testing it on us.
rolls.outro: Nobody would look at the camera. Out here you don't want to be remembered.

photos.note: Adam trying to bring the generator back. Still no gas.
Tanny wiring today's car doors into the fence. We had company.
Mateen's garden on the roof. Jaylozy on watch.
Victoria making supper. Asa didn't leave that chair all night.
Seth on the radio after dark. Nothing but static.

rolls.intro: Sam, Jeremy and Jaylozy cleared the Pier 9 warehouse.
rolls.outro: 32 rations of food, a crate of bayonets, and 6 of our last 8 rounds gone.

photos.note: Walking in. Something already standing in the loading door.
Jaylozy took the shot.
Inside. It wasn't alone.
32 rations of food in one crate.
Jeremy found these. He kept one.
Six of our last eight rounds.
Hauling it home.
